style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A softly lit cartoon cobalt canyon barrier with useful native improvements to worn stone volume, broad readable facets, crevices and restrained purposeful detail. It retains the exact registered modular contact, camera and scale contract, and reads as one continuous rock formation when independently repeated in every required facing at game size.
modelingFreedom: Reward improved forms, proportions, structural construction and purposeful decoration within the functional envelope.
Original weak part counts, rectangular surface plates, flat interior planes and redundant interior structures are not constraints.

The target's broad stone masses, softly worn facets and material articulation are aesthetic goals; reproducing every target crack, small pebble, outline or rounded joining corner is unnecessary and may violate continuity.

immutableContract.identity: rock-wall-middle; W11 cobalt canyon rock barrier, blocking terrain

registration.processing: Whole-frame uniform publication reduction only; no per-view subject fitting, cropping, recoloring or registration warp.
registration.cameraAuthority: inputs/source-camera.json; restore this registered camera rather than the full library's incidental saved 35-degree presentation camera.

footprintAndClearance.mainContactMass: Full one-cell X/Y ground contact; no empty front strip or hovering broad body.
footprintAndClearance.interpretation: Keep one-cell gameplay footprint, original contact/clearance and height budget. Interior/crown redesign may use the declared 1.17 height; do not add overhang beyond the source's small 0.011 side relief allowance or extend past native X connector planes.

connectors.repeatAxis: Native X, one world unit between adjacent roots
connectors.discovery: Confirmed in the actual full_width_continuous_crag endpoint vertices at both X planes and in the named _rock_wall native recipe. Low shoulder cross-section lies inside the outer profile; it does not substitute a new outside end profile.
connectors.requiredContinuity: Preserve the exact joining planes and external end profile. At internal joins there must be no new endcap, relief overhang, alpha gap, perimeter border, crown step, normal crease, shading reset or color discontinuity. Geometry and material continuity must survive independent publication and real consumer sampling.

immutableContract.lighting: No preferred horizontal world-light direction and no directional cast or ground shadow. One native capture/material recipe across all facings. Softer shading is welcome while preserving darker lower surfaces and the cobalt family.

aestheticCriteria.good: Several substantial worn stone masses/facets and a coherent crown describe thick canyon rock; the asset no longer reads as a blank slab decorated with rectangular plates. Forms remain useful and readable in all four facings. Functional endpoint surfaces retain their locked profile.

Cyan-blue upper planes, cobalt midtones and deeper blue recesses retain the original palette identity. Soft transitions separate stone volumes; the bottom retains useful information instead of merging into an unstructured navy-black band.

Broad soft highlights reveal worn edges and facets without glossy white ribbons, icy/neon glow or a left/right light cue. All rotated views have the same material character and clear form; repeated modules do not reveal a lighting reset.

Broad irregular planes and restrained crevices read as worn stone rather than smooth plastic, a flat painted card or noisy speckle. Small stones or crafted detail have a purposeful relation to the larger form and do not become isolated floating decals. Native modeling/material methods are the editor's choice.

At 128px logical and 32px phone cell pitch, the major stone structure remains distinct without black dead spots, coplanar shimmer, harsh plate edges, clipped corners, halos or muddy merged forms. Transparent silhouettes composite cleanly over light, neutral gray and dark backgrounds.

Independent three-module repeated runs match the connected native formation at the locked placements and remain visually seamless in N/E/S/W, including relevant fractional sample phases. No hidden border or top/crown seam becomes visible after reduction.

rankedReviewPriorities.outcome: Readable worn stone volume and broad facets replace materially blank planes in every view.
Soft cobalt form shading preserves lower detail without horizontal light bias or harsh near-black banding.
Exact functional joins and seamless visible shading/alpha remain intact in native and independently published repeated contexts at real use sizes.

requiredEvidence.nativeAsset: Hash-bound editable .blend, exact capture/render recipe and used-resource closure. Compact audit must identify the actual collection/root, intrinsic transform, publisher facing transform, camera matrices/calibration/pixel aspect, native/publication sizes, evaluated envelope, contacts and endpoint profile. Show the result is native geometry/material rendering rather than a target card or paint-over.
requiredEvidence.staticFrames: Retain all four full native 768x1408 RGBA captures, exact published 384x704 frames/atlases and relevant source/recipe/settings. Hash-bind these bytes and any previews to the candidate packet.
requiredEvidence.nativeAssemblies: For N/E/S/W, compare an independently assembled three-module run at exact projected root spacing with a connected native geometry capture under the same locked camera, registration and material settings. Inspect at logical 128 and phone 32 cell pitch. Show local RGB and alpha around internal cut planes; do not prove only coincident port centers.
requiredEvidence.consumerChecks: The actual current consumer for rock-wall-middle is the browser SVG catalog. Use its object-review.jsx SpriteScene and sprite-layout.js publication/registration path at 128 and 32 cell pitches plus representative fractional scale/root/pixel phases produced by fit sizing and panning. Compare independently repeated modules against connected native geometry at the same registered placements. Published atlas frames are embedded in logical SVG rectangles with the authored root and frame region. Image-library reduction alone is not browser consumer proof.
requiredEvidence.consumerApplicability: Verified catalog_contract.py SELECTION and godot/assets/catalog/manifest.json both contain 34 restaurant objects and exclude rock-wall-middle and the rock-wall family. Therefore an unused Godot bench is not required for this review. Current restaurant visuals use native_world_layer/native_pixel_compositor with shared native composition, reduction viewports and a presenter; the retained LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS setting alone does not describe that normal-room pipeline. Technical source hashes and applicability facts are retained in reviews/consumer-source-facts.json.
requiredEvidence.futureGodotVerification: Pending if rock-wall-middle is later introduced as a Godot consumer. At that point verify its actual native renderer, registration, sampling, repeated joins and use sizes. This middle review must not claim Godot shipping or Godot consumer proof now.
requiredEvidence.compactCoverage: A bounded reproducible bench may enumerate scale/phase/facing cases and record compact maxima/hashes/metrics. Retain a small set of representative and actual worst-case consumer images with exact reproduction parameters, including light/gray/dark composites. No massive image grid, giant raw mesh JSON or tens of thousands of GPU capture files is necessary.
requiredEvidence.visualAcceptance: The judge inspects every static facing and native repeated context, plus representative/worst consumer evidence directly or through verified labeled sheets. Numerical seam metrics and source hashes support visual inspection; they do not establish stone quality or seamless appearance by themselves.
requiredEvidence.scope: Four static frames only. No animation, locomotion, rig deformation or loop grids are required. Mixed edge/corner/end-family approval is outside this middle-only review; its approved recipe may guide later fresh independent pairs.

qualityCriteria.reviewRule: Candidate-specific approval requires visible material improvement, all required views, passing locked native contract and sufficient repeat/consumer evidence. Missing applicable evidence yields needs_evidence. Source/target differences alone are not defects, and success scores have no automatic numeric pass threshold. Report at most three material blockers with desired visible outcomes rather than editor implementation prescriptions.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
